meta.purpose: Prioritise DuoForge implementation work (Pokemon, moves, items, abilities) by real-world usage in Pokemon Champions VGC 2026 Regulation M-C
meta.retrieval_method: WebSearch and WebFetch only (no downloads, no logins). Values were read from fetched text and transcribed by hand; every table was validated with arithmetic invariants (see validation).

format.showdown_definition: Commit 812501e 'Add Champions Regulation M-C' (KrisXV; date not shown on the commit page, a search snippet gave 2026-09-09): mod 'champions', gameType 'doubles', ruleset ['Flat Rules', 'VGC Timer', 'Open Team Sheets']
format.regulation_window_in_game: Reg M-C live from 2026-09-08 19:00 PDT (2026-09-09 02:00 UTC) to 2026-12-01 17:59 PST (2026-12-02 01:59 UTC); adds 24 Pokemon and 6 Mega Evolutions (Salamence, Golisopod, Baxcalibur and Absol/Garchomp/Lucario Z) to M-B (https://www.pokemon.com/us/news/get-ready-for-regulation-set-m-c-in-pokemon-champions)

meta.month_used_note: The 2026-09 directory was generated on 2026-10-01 (index timestamp 01-Oct-2026 14:40). It is the first and only monthly Smogon release for Reg M-C so far, covering roughly 2026-09-09 to 2026-09-30 (about 3 weeks of a brand-new regulation).

sources.note: The fetch tool truncates this file after about 41-42 Pokemon (about 79% of team slots); ranks 42+ were not readable.

urls: https://www.smogon.com/stats/2026-09/chaos/gen9championsvgc2026regmc-1500.json (exists; larger than 10 MB, so the fetch tool rejected it)

sources.note: Pikalytics: 200 M-C teams tracked (92 readable); Pokebase shows "528 results" for M-C events (unit not stated); events come from Limitless, RK9 and Victory Road.
Top-500 ladder only (no usage data): Elo 1833 at rank 1, 1767 at rank 10, 1596 at rank 500; Glicko-1 of the top player about 1732-1766.

meta.recommended_use: Prioritise with cutoff1500 (large sample, mild skill weighting); use cutoff0 (unweighted, all players) as the robustness check. Treat 1630/1760 as noisy.

sections.pokemon_top60_cutoff1500_order: Top 60 species/forms with usage % at all four cutoffs, raw/real counts, cumulative coverage and the tournament-team unlock counts
sections.pokemon_ranks_61_140_cutoff1500: Ranks 61-140 (cutoff 1500) with the cutoff-0 rank and value
sections.pokemon_full_ranking_cutoff0: All 341 rows of the unweighted table
sections.top30_details: Abilities, items, moves, top-10 teammates for ranks 1-30 (cutoff 1500, plus the cutoff-0 equivalent where readable)
sections.details_ranks_31_41: Same for ranks 31-41 (the last ones the fetch tool could read)
sections.weighted_rankings: Overall item/ability/move rankings = usage x share; cutoff 1500 (41 Pokemon) and cutoff 0 (38 Pokemon), stability and bundle sizes
sections.coverage_curve: Share of team slots and of the 92 tournament teams covered by implementing the top N Pokemon
sections.tournament_team_check: 92 readable Reg M-C tournament teams and what blocks them

definitions.usage_pct_cutoff0: Share of all teams (2 per battle) containing the species at team preview = raw_teams / (2 x battles). Sums to exactly 600% over the 341 rows (6 Pokemon per team). Unweighted, all ladder players.
definitions.usage_pct_cutoff1500_1630_1760: Same share but every team is weighted by a rating-based weight (Smogon cutoff weighting); average weight per team is 0.545 / 0.081 / 0.004. 1500 is the usual Smogon baseline and is used as the primary ranking here. At 1760 the weight sits on the very top of the ladder (on 2026-10-01 the 10th-best ladder entry had Elo 1767 and the best Glicko-1 value was about 1766), so 1630/1760 rest on a small group of players.
definitions.raw_teams: Number of team slots containing the species (identical in all cutoff files).
definitions.real_battled / real_pct: Times the species was actually sent out in a battle; real_pct is normalised so the column sums to 600%.
definitions.moveset shares: abilities and items: % of the species' (weighted) sets, sum 100. moves: % of sets running the move, sum 400 (four moves; "Other" is the unlisted remainder). teammates: P(teammate is on the team | species is on the team), top 10 only.
definitions.per_100_teams (weighted rankings): Sum over Pokemon of usage fraction x share within that Pokemon, times 100: the expected number of Pokemon-slots per 100 teams that carry the item/ability/move. For items this equals the % of teams holding the item because Flat Rules include Item Clause (no value exceeds 100). For moves and abilities it is an expected user count and an upper bound on the % of teams with at least one user (e.g. Protect = about 3 users per team).
definitions.tourney92 columns: Counts out of the 92 readable top-finishing Reg M-C tournament teams. teams_unlocked_here = teams whose lowest-ranked member (cutoff-1500 order) is this Pokemon; fully_covered_cum = teams entirely inside the top-N.

validation.usage_table_cutoff0: All 341 rows transcribed; sum of Usage % = 600.000, sum of Raw = 19,583,316 = 12 x battles exactly, and every row satisfies Usage % = Raw / (2 x battles); rank order strictly non-increasing.
validation.weighted_tables: Ranks contiguous, usage non-increasing, all names present in the cutoff-0 table.
validation.moveset_blocks: For every Pokemon: ability shares sum to 100 (+-0.05), item shares to 100 (+-0.05), move shares to 400 (+-0.1), 10 teammates sorted descending.
validation.teammate_symmetry: P(B|A) x P(A) vs P(A|B) x P(B): 202 pairs at cutoff 1500 (max relative error 2.2%) and 188 pairs at cutoff 0 (max <2%), which also confirms that no block was mislabeled.
validation.item_clause: No weighted item total exceeds 100 teams per 100 teams, consistent with Item Clause.
validation.excluded: The cutoff-0 moveset blocks for Pawmot, Primarina and Swampert-Mega were unreadable or corrupted (page truncation) and are left out; the cutoff-0 weighted ranking therefore uses 38 Pokemon.
validation.moveset_raw_count_note: The "Raw count" in moveset files is about 12-14% larger than the Raw column of the usage files (different counting); the share columns are internally consistent, and only the usage files feed the per-team figures.

implications_for_engine: Mega Evolution is unavoidable: expected Mega-capable Pokemon per team is at least 1.64 (cutoff 1500) / 1.66 (cutoff 0); all 92 readable tournament teams contain one.

Terrain-setting abilities are the most used abilities: Grassy Surge 42.8 and Psychic Surge 29.3 per 100 teams (cutoff 1500). Weather setters: Drizzle 20.4, Drought 15.4, Snow Warning 8.5, Sand Stream 6.7. Intimidate 29.3, Unburden 32.3 (Sneasler), Prankster 13.8.
Protect is on about 3 Pokemon per team and Fake Out on about 1 per team; Trick Room (49) and Tailwind (42) per 100 teams are the main speed-control moves.

10 of the top 30 are Mega forms, each tied to its Mega Stone at 100% share: Salamence-Mega, Golisopod-Mega, Raichu-Mega-Y, Charizard-Mega-Y, Gardevoir-Mega, Floette-Mega, Garchomp-Mega-Z, Tyranitar-Mega, Staraptor-Mega, Metagross-Mega.
gaps: Item/move/ability shares exist only for the top 41 Pokemon (about 79% of team slots at cutoff 1500); the unlisted remainder (~21% of slots, plus the "Other" rows) is not in the weighted rankings, so the figures are lower bounds for the full ladder.
Smogon publishes marginal usage and top-10 conditional teammates only, not joint team compositions; "teams unlocked" is approximated with 92 tournament teams (a small, winner-biased sample).
Only one month (about 3 weeks of a new regulation) exists; the meta is still moving and the ladder is not tournament play. The 1630/1760 cutoffs have tiny effective samples.
Not extracted: EV/nature spreads, checks and counters, the chaos JSON, the Bo3 ladder files, and the previous regulation (M-B) files, all of which exist on the same site.
Pikalytics numbers are undated, merge Mega forms into base species and could not be reproduced; they were not used for rankings.

weighted_rankings.definition: per_100_teams = sum over covered Pokemon of (usage fraction x share within that Pokemon) x 100; see meta.definitions. Primary = cutoff1500 (rating-weighted, 41 Pokemon). cutoff0_all_players uses unweighted data for 38 Pokemon and shows the ranking is stable.

tournament_team_check.source: https://www.pikalytics.com/topteams (Reg M-C tournament teams, linked to Limitless; page header says "200 Teams"; only the first 92 were readable through the fetch tool)
caveats: Top-finishing teams only (records 4-0 .. 13-1), so biased toward strong/standard teams; not a ladder sample.
Duplicate or near-duplicate copy-pasted teams occur (e.g. the Swampert-Mega/Pelipper/Archaludon/Grimmsnarl/Charizard-Mega-Y/Venusaur team appears 4 times).
Pikalytics name "Floette-Eternal-Mega" was mapped to the Smogon/Showdown name "Floette-Mega".

metagame_styles_cutoff1500.note: Smogon team-style labels (heuristic, designed for singles-like play; labels overlap and sum above 100). Weather labels match the weather-ability totals computed from the moveset data, so those are usable as a sanity check; stall/semistall/balance are not meaningful for VGC.

leads_cutoff1500.note: File header "Total leads: 3263886" equals 2 x battles, i.e. one lead per team; exact lead definition for doubles not documented, treat as indicative. Values are cutoff-1500-weighted % of teams.

cross_check_pikalytics_pokedex.note: Page states no data source, date range or sample size; species appear merged with their Mega forms; numbers do not reproduce Smogon cutoff-0/1500/1630/1760 values. Its sibling team-builder page says "Usage data last updated May 2026". Use only as a rough cross-check.
